dialogues.speaker: Liloa
dialogues.text: Hello. I am the stage designer here.

dialogues.speaker: Liloa
dialogues.text: ...Although, it's probably more accurate to say I work with everything to do with the tourism industry of the tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Liloa
dialogues.text: After all, the tourism industry is our main source of income. Besides public performances, I also work with music production and site promotions.
